name: The First Reopening
summary: The first modern Mythos Gate opens under impossible pressure. The Creator learns how Titans, Gates, Hollow leakage, and Director governance function.
loreDirectorNotes: Introduces canon without adding playable non-Titan entries or ordinary units. Mesha and the Hollow Mouth are non-playable narrative anchors.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Designed as the onboarding campaign: single active deity selection, map objectives, enemy turns, and Gate sealing through one active deity.
artDirectorNotes: Needs approved artwork for the First Reopening Gate, Mesha, Hollow Wretch, and TG-TITAN-001.
developmentDirectorNotes: Campaign can be expanded from current game/index.html without replacing the playable loop.
recommendedNextTask: Create chapter-select UI using campaign data.
